title: Fluorescently Labeled Polyamine Uptake via Confocal Microscopy
author: Sarah van Veen

steps.title: Seed cells on coverslips
steps.instruction: Place cover slips in a 12‑well or 24‑well plate, seed cells onto them, and allow attachment and growth for approximately 24 hours.

steps.title: Add fluorescent polyamines
steps.instruction: On the day of the experiment, remove the cell culture medium and add fluorescently labeled polyamines to each well in a final volume of 1000 µL per well. Choose concentration and incubation time appropriate for the cell type (testing multiple doses and times is recommended).

steps.title: Incubate with polyamines
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ for the desired duration, keeping the samples protected from light.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Fix cells by adding 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS and incubate for 30 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash cells post‑fixation
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS‑T, each wash lasting 5 minutes, at room temperature on a rocker.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with DAPI diluted 1:5000 in PBS‑T for 15 minutes at room temperature, protected from light and on a rocker.

steps.title: Wash cells post‑DAPI
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS‑T, each wash lasting 5 minutes, on a rocker and protected from light.

steps.title: Overnight PBS‑T wash
steps.instruction: Wash cells overnight with PBS‑T at 4 °C on a rocker, protected from light.

steps.title: Set slides overnight
steps.instruction: Allow the slides to set overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount coverslips with FluorSave
steps.instruction: Mount the coverslips onto glass slides using FluorSave™ mounting medium.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Image the samples on a Zeiss LSM880 (or equivalent) confocal microscope using a 63× objective.
